text: Accepted UIDL handling narrows the message list to the requested UIDL, then calls _actionDone(NS_ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) and returns if the message is no longer on the server. This status reaches the channel/URL completion path. No browser error page test was added in the inspected landing, so the source proves status propagation rather than rendered error-page behavior. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: A removed single POP3 UIDL fails instead of silently completing a download
